cohort: Maternal deaths at Chris Hani Baragwanath Maternity Hospital (CHBMH) in Greater Soweto, Johannesburg, South Africa
finding: Maternal mortality ratio declined in Greater Soweto after the introduction of HIV treatment for pregnant women in 2004, but previous caesarean section, advanced maternal age, and anaemia were associated with death from obstetric haemorrhage, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, and nonpregnancy-related infections, respectively.
mod_finding: Previous caesarean section was associated with obstetric haemorrhage death.
